variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a public scandal
variants.sub: A party leader is the subject of a newly revealed scandal.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A scandal concerning a party leader had come to light in {colony}.

Reputation matters, but sound judgment requires more than a scandal label. A commercial assessment should avoid inferring a financial loss, a regulatory consequence or an administrative change that has not been established. Confidence should rest on a careful account, particularly when political controversy encourages hasty conclusions.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We consider {target} unfairly served by a rush to condemnation. A scandal's existence is not a complete account of responsibility, and a fair hearing remains worth defending even in unwelcome publicity.
